description: Sabaragamuwa  Provincial Council   -  By-Laws of  Bulathkohupitiya   Pradeshiya  Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval and publication of a new by-law regulating dangerous and unpleasant businesses within the Bulathkohupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha area. It establishes legal requirements, licensing procedures, and regulatory compliance standards for business operations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions a government official (the Governor), it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on the creation of a regulatory instrument.
